rca_of_issue: Original user report: 'Android APK silently fails when sending OTP, no admin log entry, no errors visible'. Root-cause hypothesis (confirmed reasonable by this code): EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL was either (a) empty/undefined in the production APK bundle (so axios baseURL fell back to 'https://invalid.localhost/api' which silently fails), or (b) the previous catch{} in otp.tsx swallowed the network error without showing any toast. Mitigation in this iter: client.ts now logs structured JSON on every axios failure (visible via `adb logcat | grep api/client`) AND throws explicitly if BACKEND_URL is missing; otp.tsx replaced silent catch with describeAxiosError + describeFirebaseError toasts and shows a red banner above the form when !isBackendConfigured(); a dedicated diagnostics screen lets the user self-verify connectivity and copy a one-shot report. Reproduction on web preview: NOT reproducible here because EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is correctly inlined (verified: BACKEND_URL='https://wealth-growth-mobile.preview.emergentagent.com', ping=200, OTP probe=200, admin log entry confirmed). The real reproduction would require the user's APK build env.
